text:
jess_cs: @here quick sync — Acme go-live in ~72h. We need a finalized SLO acceptance checklist + the customer-facing explanation of uptime/latency targets and how credits will be calculated. They specifically asked for clarity on measurement windows and evidence bundles.

marco_sre: OK. I can own the measurement and evidence side. Quick Q: which routes/models are in scope for the SLA? (chat vs embeddings vs rerank)

jess_cs: main routes: chat (gpt-like), embeddings for search, and a small rerank flow for recommendations. We'll call them out in the doc.

marco_sre: Proposed SLOs (draft):
```
- Uptime: 99.95% (calendar month)
- Latency: p95 gen < 300ms, p99 gen < 900ms (end-to-end, customer request -> final token)
- Embeddings: p95 < 120ms
- Rerank: p95 < 400ms

Credit bands (monthly):
- uptime >= 99.95%: no credit
- 99.90% <= uptime < 99.95%: 5% credit
- 99.50% <= uptime < 99.90%: 15% credit
- uptime < 99.50%: 25% credit (cap)

Measurement: rolling 28-day windows vs calendar month? I prefer rolling 28-day for stability.
```

sana_enable: I can create the one-pager and an onboarding snippet that explains how we measure (dashboards + sample query). Will include screenshots and a short recorded walkthrough (10min). :white_check_mark:

liam_am: Acme legal asked for explicit maintenance windows and how credits are applied to invoices. Need a single-sentence line they can paste into the MSAs. Also can we keep the credit calc deterministic? They dislike vague "pro-rated" language.

olivia_legal: Draft language suggestion: "Credits are calculated based on the mutually agreed monthly invoice and the observed uptime shortfall using the credit bands specified in Exhibit A. Credits are the exclusive remedy for service unavailability, excluding scheduled maintenance and Force Majeure events. Measurement windows are defined in Exhibit A." We should add scheduled maintenance notice period (72h) and a maximum credit cap (25%).

marco_sre: Noted. Two technical points: 1) scheduled maintenance must be excluded from measurement (we already do), 2) define what telemetry counts (server-side successful responses only, exclude client aborts). I'll add the SQL-ish query we run for p95 so it's reproducible.

marco_sre: Snippet for evidence bundle (what we'll hand to customer):
```
- Aggregated uptime graph (28d rolling + calendar month)
- Raw request logs (filtered for in-scope routes)
- Latency percentiles (p50/p90/p95/p99) with query used to compute
- Incident timeline + root cause analysis for any downtime during period
```

jess_cs: Perfect. Action items:
- marco_sre: finalize measurement expressions, evidence bundle format, and include the exact query we run (ETA: 6h)
- sana_enable: assemble the customer one-pager + 10m walkthrough (ETA: EOD)
- olivia_legal: wire the MSA language and Exhibit A text (ETA: EOD)
- liam_am: confirm Acme will accept rolling 28-day vs calendar month and share any legal asks (you own the ask)

liam_am: I'll ping them now. If they push calendar month, flag back here.

ops_bot: Incident reminder: scheduled maintenance window on 4789457600-4789461200 (3/22) — marked as excluded from SLA calculations.

marco_sre: small follow-up on credit calc: we should include a sample numeric example in the doc so customers understand. E.g. monthly fee $20k, observed uptime 99.80% -> shortfall 0.15% -> band = 15% credit -> credit = $3k. I'll add 2 examples (low and high).

sana_enable: I'll add that example to the one-pager so AMs can use it in renewal talks.

olivia_legal: Also add line "Credits will be applied to the next invoice after calculation." That avoids disputes about retro refunds.

jess_cs: Great. If everyone hits ETAs we can bundle this into a single "SLO acceptance packet" to send to Acme by EOD and schedule the 30-min walkthrough tomorrow. Any objections?

marco_sre: no objections. :thumbsup:

sana_enable: all good.

liam_am: good to go from my side after I hear back from Acme.

olivia_legal: LGTM pending minor edits.

jess_cs: Thanks team — I'll stitch things together and post the packet here once done. I'll also add an 'acceptance checkbox' in the doc for Acme to sign off. :rocket:
